import colorsys

colors = [
    \('#2E7D32', 'Primary'\),
    \('#6AAF4A', 'Fresh Green'\),
    \('#C4451A', 'Accent'\),
    \('#EEF5E9', 'Background'\),
    \('#1B2E1A', 'Dark'\),
    \('#F5F9F2', 'Light'\),
    \('#5A6B55', 'Text Muted'\),
    \('#D5DBC8', 'Border'\),
]

for hex_color, label in colors:
    r = int\(hex_color[1:3], 16\) / 255.0
    g = int\(hex_color[3:5], 16\) / 255.0
    b = int\(hex_color[5:7], 16\) / 255.0
    h, l, s = colorsys.rgb_to_hls\(r, g, b\)
    h_deg = round\(h * 360\)
    s_pct = round\(s * 100\)
    l_pct = round\(l * 100\)
    print\(f'{label}: {h_deg} {s_pct}% {l_pct}%'\)
")

Bash(psql "$DATABASE_URL" -c "
ALTER TABLE chef_profiles ADD COLUMN first_name text;
ALTER TABLE chef_profiles ADD COLUMN last_name text;
ALTER TABLE chef_profiles ADD COLUMN email text;
ALTER TABLE chef_profiles ADD COLUMN phone text;

-- Migrate existing data: parse 'Chef FirstName LastName' format
UPDATE chef_profiles SET
  first_name = CASE
    WHEN name LIKE 'Chef %' THEN split_part\(substring\(name from 6\), ' ', 1\)
    ELSE split_part\(name, ' ', 1\)
  END,
  last_name = CASE
    WHEN name LIKE 'Chef %' THEN
      CASE
        WHEN array_length\(string_to_array\(substring\(name from 6\), ' '\), 1\) > 1
        THEN array_to_string\(\(string_to_array\(substring\(name from 6\), ' '\)\)[2:], ' '\)
        ELSE ''
      END
    ELSE
      CASE
        WHEN array_length\(string_to_array\(name, ' '\), 1\) > 1
        THEN array_to_string\(\(string_to_array\(name, ' '\)\)[2:], ' '\)
        ELSE ''
      END
  END;

-- Make columns NOT NULL after populating
ALTER TABLE chef_profiles ALTER COLUMN first_name SET NOT NULL;
ALTER TABLE chef_profiles ALTER COLUMN last_name SET NOT NULL;

-- Drop the old name column
ALTER TABLE chef_profiles DROP COLUMN name;
" 2>&1)
